summary.text: Rob Clements is a member of the Nebraska Unicameral Legislature representing District 2, and was appointed on February 6, 2017, to replace Bill Kintner, who resigned, then was elected in 2018 and re-elected in 2022, according to the Legislature's biography.
The Legislature lists Rob Clements's occupation as a banker, insurance agent and tax preparer, and formerly worked as an actuary.

paragraphs.text: Rob Clements was born on December 11, 1950, in Lincoln.
Rob Clements graduated from Elmwood Public School in 1969 and earned a B.S. in math, with honors, from the University of Nebraska-Lincoln in 1973.
Rob Clements is president of the Bess Streeter Aldrich Foundation.
Rob Clements married Peggy Sue Bogenreif on December 24, 1972, and they have five children and 14 grandchildren.
